rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING MALASAKIT CENTERS TO COMPLEMENT THE IMPLEMENTATION OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 11223 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE êžŒUNIVERSAL HEALTH CARE ACTêžŒ BY REQUIRING PHILHEALTH TO ESTABLISH, OPERATE AND MAINTAIN MALASAKIT CENTERS IN ALL DOH, LGU, SUC AND DND HOSPITALS IN THE COUNTRY, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to complement the implementation of Universal Health Care Act (R.A. No. 11223) by establishing
a Malasakit Center in each DOH, LGU, DND and SUC hospital which shall serve as a) processing center
for all PhilHealth concerns regarding coverage and referral to the health care provider network; and
b) one-stop shop medical assistance to cover out-of-pocket medical expenses of indigent and poor patients.

Provides for the definition of Poor Patients as distinguished from Indigent Patients:  
Indigent Patients - patient who has no visible means of income, or whose income is insufficient for the subsistence of his/her family, as identified by the DSWD, LGU social worker or the medical social worker of the health facility.

Poor Patients refers to those not classified as indigent but are otherwise considered poor or, with financial difficulty to access adequate medical care and/or pay hospital bills because of certain unavoidable circumstances as enumerated in this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05477

rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING ADDITIONAL ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS FOR BIDDERS AND CONTRACTORS TO PARTICIPATE IN THE PROCUREMENT PROCESS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the inadequacy of the provisions in R.A. No.9184 due to evident-based manipulation or collusion which still exist in the bidding process in government procurement although the law clearly prohibits other attempts to subvert the said practice.

Mandates that bidders and contractors who participate in the public bidding or who deal with the government in the implementation of infrastructure projects, must operate within the area or region where the project is to be implemented and must secure an Authority to Participate from the Regional Director and the Undersecretary for Operations of the DPWH.
rows.status: Referred to Stakeholders on 2019-09-11

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING REFORMS IN REAL PROPERTY VALUATION AND ASSESSMENT IN THE PHILIPPINES, REORGANIZING THE BUREAU OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT FINANCE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to promote the development and maintenance of just, equitable, impartial, and nationally 
consistent real property valuation by establishing appraisal standards, methods and procedures 
of property valuations and assessment.

Intends to assist the Local Government Units in maximizing revenue collections, which in turn, will promote genuine local autonomy.

Provides for the following provisions: a) powers and functions of the Bureau of Local Government Finance (BLGF); b) establishment of the Real Property Valuation Service; c) creation of a Central Consultative Committee; d) role of the BLGF Regional Offices; e) Regional Consultative Committee and its function; f) Valuation Standards and Market Values; g) development and maintenance of real property market database, and others.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04664
